text: God be with you, my child. May I offer you a blessing?
speaker: p243

text: Peace be with you, friend. Go safely on your road.
speaker: p243

text: Benedicat te omnipotens Deus. Go in peace, my child.
speaker: p243

text: The Lord keep you. If you are hungry, the brothers will share their bread.
speaker: p243

text: You are hurt. Sit a moment, and let me see. I know a little of herbs.
speaker: p243

text: God speed us both. I am going your way, and the road is safer in company.
speaker: p243

text: Benedicat te omnipotens Deus, Pater, et Filius, et Spiritus Sanctus. Go in peace, my child.
speaker: p243

text: God reward you, my child. The brothers live on such kindness, and we will pray for you.
speaker: p243

text: If you need a bed tonight, the friary will take you in. And they say the road to Bath is safe by day.
speaker: p243

text: Pax vobiscum. Welcome to the house of Our Lady of Glastonbury. May I offer you a blessing?
speaker: p243

text: God keep you, pilgrim. Say a prayer before Our Lady, and go in peace.
speaker: p243

text: Peace be with you. If you are hungry, the almoner gives bread at the gate.
speaker: p243

text: Go to the almonry by the gate. The almoner gives bread to all who ask, for the love of God.
speaker: p243

text: Pilgrims are lodged in the guest hall. Ask the hosteller, and you shall have a bed and a meal tonight.
speaker: p243

text: You are hurt. Come with me: the infirmarian will see to you.
speaker: p243
